_comment: Copy to settings.local.json (gitignored) and edit. The file lives in the Config folder of the data root: the project folder in the Editor; in a player the folder of HS2Next.exe when a file portable.txt lies next to it, else the folder the environment variable HS2NEXT_DATA_ROOT names, else the per-user folder %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\stp3\HS2Next (each holds Config/settings.local.json, UserData/ and Cache/; -settings <file> reads another file). Without the file the app starts with the defaults and asks for the HS2 folder. Paths are absolute or relative to the data root; use forward slashes or escaped backslashes. hs2Root: HS2 install folder (contains abdata and mods). modsFolders: extra zipmod folders, lower priority than the install. cacheDir: empty = <data root>/Cache (a folder that cannot be written falls back to the per-user folder, with a warning).
_comment_aiInstall: aiInstall: the HS2 install shows the AI-Shoujo content of the Studio lists (the game's IsInstallAI; true = what HS2 Studio showed on the reference install, false = hide it as a machine without AI-Shoujo would).
_comment_sideloader: sideloaderZipmodSet: the zipmods are the set Sideloader loads (a zipmod whose <game> names no HS2 game is skipped, one file per GUID by the manifest version, GUID load order). sideloaderAssetRedirect: a named load from a bundle path that several sources ship is served by the first copy in load order that holds the name, as Sideloader serves it. false = the 4.3 behaviour (after a restart); -sideloader on|off sets both for one run.
_comment_content: content: the catalog's memory. bundleCacheMB: the byte budget (MB) of the bundles no part of the scene holds any more; beyond it the oldest are unloaded without destroying what was loaded from them (0 = all at once; -bundleCacheMB N for one run). unloadUnusedMinSec: at least this many seconds between two unloads of unused assets the app makes by itself, at quiet moments. texturePrescan: true: the player checks every bundle's textures in the background after boot (once per machine, verdicts cached); the Editor never does (-texturePrescan asks for it, -noTexturePrescan turns it off for one run); false = each bundle is checked when it is first opened.
_comment_maps: mapAudioLink: a player creates the junction <player folder>/abdata -> <hs2Root>/abdata so that the vanilla map clips find their sample data (their relative resource path; never a copy, never replacing an existing folder); default false: the map clips stay silent either way, the link only silences the audio engine's missing-file lines, and a user's app folder gets no link into the game data (a development setup may turn it on). maps.audioLinkEditor: also in the Editor, where Unity looks in <parent of the project folder>/abdata (outside the project; default false). maps.maxMirrors: mirrors rendered per frame (0-16).
_comment_userData: HS2Next's own UserData (scene/, chara/, coordinate/, Bridge/); empty = <data root>/UserData (the project's is gitignored); a folder that cannot be written falls back to the per-user folder, with a warning. One app at a time uses a UserData folder (app.lock). The HS2 install's UserData is only read.
_comment_app: app.autoStart: the app (catalog, scene, bridge) starts by itself in every Editor play session and player (-noApp turns it off). app.frameRate: Application.targetFrameRate, 0 = Unity's (batch mode: 60). app.runInBackground: true keeps the app running and answering the bridge while another window has the focus; false pauses an unfocused windowed app (batch-mode players run regardless).
_comment_render: render: the rendering options, applied at load (app.options render changes them while the app runs): aa smaa | taa | fxaa | none (anti-aliasing), taaQuality veryLow | low | medium | high | veryHigh, grading hs2 | hdr (colour grading), ambient hs2 | environment (ambient light), lightFalloff hs2 | urp (light attenuation), shadowDistance 10-400, backgroundColor [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] in 0-1, ssr off | on (screen-space reflections, experimental; default off although HS2 draws them; drawn only where the scene's SSR flag is on).
_comment_kinematics: kinematics: the FK / IK options, applied at load (app.options kinematics changes them while the app runs): exclusive (switching FK on switches IK off and the reverse, the vanilla preset), rotationLimits (the elbow / knee interior-angle limit of the two-bone solve) with limitMinInterior (degrees, 0-179), missingTargetsFirstFrame (the vanilla first-frame copy of missing IK targets).
_comment_ui: ui: the Studio UI. enabled starts it (-ui / -noUi; batch runs and the -smoke / -bridgeAccept players keep it off unless asked). The other members are the options' developer defaults, below options.json and the command line: language (en, ja, zh-Hans), scale (or uiScale: 75-200), preset (or keyPreset: default, hs2studio), and option sections in the options.json shape, e.g. maker.keepColours (an item change keeps the item's colours, the HS2 Maker's habit; default false), maker.copyAccessoryPluginData (a slot copy on the Accessories page also copies the source's MaterialEditor items, DynamicBoneEditor entries and Additional Accessory Controls rules, as those plugins do; default false = vanilla), maker.accessoryHandles (the move / rotate handles of the selected accessory's transform sets in the viewport; default true), studio.blood (a shot shows blood, droplets and marks on the floor; default true; the Options panel's Show blood).
_comment_bridge: Automation bridge on 127.0.0.1. enabled (-bridge / -noBridge), port 1024-65535 (-bridgePort N), token: require the X-HS2Next-Token header, true = a random token at each start, a string = that token, false or "" = off (-bridgeToken [value]; the token is written to <userData>/Bridge/token, where the automation clients read it); default: required in the distributed build, off in development builds and the Editor (this example says true, so a copied example keeps the distributed build's protection), outputDir: captures and dumps, empty = <userData>/Bridge (-bridgeOutputDir), allowQuit: accept app.quit (-bridgeAllowQuit).
_comment_studio: studio.accessoryItems: the character accessories are offered as Studio items (item group 647158, one category per accessory kind; on by default as the loader HS2Next imitates does it); false = the group is absent and stored items of it stay unresolved (written back unchanged).
_comment_plugins: plugins: the plugin loader. enabled: plugins load from the plugin folder (-noPlugins turns them off for one run; the environment variable HS2NEXT_NO_PLUGINS=1, which the test runner sets, too). dir: the plugin folder, empty = the Plugins folder next to the app (the project folder in the Editor); each plugin is a subfolder <guid> with manifest.json; -pluginsDir <dir> overrides it and the switches. disabled: plugin GUIDs that do not load.
